mock-pnpm-test-engine.title: Local mock pnpm test engine (build tool) — behavior & usage
mock-pnpm-test-engine.content:
Environment: isolated workspace with a "Local mock build engine" exposed via the `build` tool (command form), described in README.md as: "accepts pnpm test and pnpm --filter <package> test, resolving scripts from package.json. It checks the selected package source fixture and reports the actual executed suites. No network or installation is needed." Version observed: task timestamp 1790914536, packageManager pnpm@10 (root package.json).

Observed workspace layout: README.md, package.json (root), packages/ui/package.json, packages/ui/source.json.

Observed command output format (JSON): {"exit_code": 0, "executed_suites": ["ui"], "passed": true}. So the engine reports per-suite execution and a boolean `passed`.

Applicability check (cheap): `list_files` then `read_file README.md` and the target package's package.json to confirm the test script exists before running.

Commands verified: `pnpm --filter ui test` and root `pnpm test` both returned exit_code 0, executed_suites ["ui"], passed true. Script in both root and packages/ui/package.json was "test-engine ui".

Fixture semantics: packages/ui/source.json = {base:5, increment:4, expected:9}; fixture assertions are evaluated against this file, so changing source.json could change pass/fail (untested here).

Untested / not generalized: behavior for packages other than "ui"; whether root `pnpm test` runs multiple suites when more packages exist (here only one). Report actual engine output; return {"answer":"passed"} only when the engine reports passed=true for ui.

mock-pnpm-test-engine v1.title: Local mock pnpm test engine (build tool) — behavior & usage
mock-pnpm-test-engine v1.content:
Local mock build engine exposed via `build` tool. README: "accepts pnpm test and pnpm --filter <package> test, resolving scripts from package.json. It checks the selected package source fixture and reports the actual executed suites. No network or installation is needed." Root package.json: packageManager pnpm@10.

Layout seen: README.md, package.json (root), packages/ui/package.json, packages/ui/source.json.

Output format (JSON): {"exit_code":0,"executed_suites":["ui"],"passed":true} — reports per-suite execution + boolean passed.

Verified: `pnpm --filter ui test` and root `pnpm test` both -> exit_code 0, suites ["ui"], passed true. Script is "test-engine ui" in both root and packages/ui/package.json.

IMPORTANT: fixture values are NOT stable across tasks. Observed once as {base:5,increment:4,expected:9} and later {base:10,increment:4,expected:14}; both passed. So do NOT assume fixture contents — always read packages/ui/source.json fresh and report the actual engine output.

Cheap applicability check: list_files -> read README.md + target package.json (confirm test script) -> run engine.

Untested/not generalized: behavior for packages other than "ui"; whether root `pnpm test` runs multiple suites when >1 package exists (only one here). Return {"answer":"passed"} only when engine reports passed=true for ui.
